name: Poisson Regression
when_to_use: Count dependent variable (integer, non-negative), assuming equidispersion (mean approximately equal to variance).

expected_input.question: How to model a count dependent variable with equidispersion?

plain_explanation.purpose: Predicts counts (how many times something happens) from factors.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When the outcome is a small integer: occurrences, calls, defects per period.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A column with counts (0, 1, 2...) and factor columns.
plain_explanation.example: Estimate the number of support tickets per week according to customer size.
